purpose: Define identity participation in Projects as explicit relations carrying role, contribution context and time scope, distinct from Project ownership, AccessCore authority and MeritCore outcome.

topics.name: Project Participation and Role
topics.purpose: Define identity participation in Projects as explicit relations carrying role, contribution context and time scope, distinct from Project ownership, AccessCore authority and MeritCore outcome.

semantics.participant_rule: Participant is an explicit IdentityCore identity linked to a Project.
semantics.role_rule: Role/contribution semantics are explicit relation metadata.
semantics.time_rule: Participation interval/atoms are explicit where machine-significant.
semantics.ownership_rule: Participation does not imply Project semantic ownership.
semantics.authority_rule: Participation does not imply administrative/execution authority.
semantics.merit_rule: Participation alone does not create merit; MeritCore consumes accepted outcome/evidence.
semantics.multi_role_rule: Identity may have multiple explicit roles over the Project lifecycle where policy permits.

invariants.rule: Project is the universal recursive work primitive; task-like semantics are represented by Projects rather than parallel task entities.

hard_gates.condition: participant role exists only in prose where machine-significant
participant becomes semantic owner of Project

references.purpose: Merit requires explicit accepted evidence beyond participation.

prose.summary: Define identity participation in Projects as explicit relations carrying role, contribution context and time scope, distinct from Project ownership, AccessCore authority and MeritCore outcome.
